sanskrit:
एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः।
कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्।।
caption:
Kṛṣṇa urges Arjuna to follow the ancients. ‘evaṁ jñātvā kṛtaṁ karma’ (All the liberated souls in ancient times acted with this understanding). ‘pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kṛtam’ (Therefore you should perform your duty in the same spirit as the ancients). Don’t invent a new path. Don’t stop working. Do the work, but know the science of work (that the soul is aloof). Sun-god Vivasvan, Manu, Ikṣvāku—they were all kings who fought wars and ruled kingdoms, yet they were liberated because they knew the ‘Tattva’ (Truth). Kṛṣṇa is essentially saying: ‘Be a Saint-King like your forefathers, not a beggar.’
